title: emerging-market-skills rules file
description: Schema for skills/*/rules.yml. Enforcement lives in tools/validate_skills.py; this file exists so editors can offer completion and inline errors. Point your YAML extension at it with a modeline: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../../tools/rules.schema.json

prefix.description: Uppercase ID prefix owned by this skill. Globally unique.

id.description: PREFIX-NNN. Globally unique and never reused, even after a rule is superseded.

rule.description: One imperative, testable sentence. No hedging.

kind.description: empirical = claims something about devices, networks, or people, and must cite evidence to be critical. process = governs how we conduct our own work and has nothing to cite.

severity.description: critical = the product does not work for the target user, and requires evidence. warning = measurable degradation. advisory = a better default a reasonable team may decline.

detect.description: What a reviewer or script looks for to find a violation.

remedy.description: The specific fix, naming the framework or API where relevant.

superseded_by.description: Set when this rule is replaced. Rules are never deleted.

tier.description: field = observed in a product we shipped. published = research or industry report. vendor = platform documentation.

source.description: For field evidence: 'Product — market, dates'. For published and vendor: a citation key with a matching '### key' heading in docs/SOURCES.md.

observation.description: Required for field evidence. What was actually observed, phrased as an observation rather than a universal constant.
